question.text: In Borax <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>7</mn></mrow></msub><mo>.</mo><mn>10</mn><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> if number of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> hybridised B-atoms are X and number of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> hybridised B-atom are Y. What is the value of sum <math><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> ?

solution.text:
In Borax 2-B-atoms are sp2 and 2-B-atoms are sp3 hybridised

X=2,Y=2

X+Y=4
